turns.patient_response: I'm just really struggling with how my face looks, especially with this awful acne and scarring all over my skin. It looks absolutely terrible to me, even though everyone else tells me they can barely see anything. I feel so self-conscious about it all the time.

symptom_reasoning.S067: The patient expresses significant distress and preoccupation regarding perceived flaws in their facial appearance (acne and scarring) that others report they can barely see.
